gpt-6-astra._note: OpenRouter model and endpoint catalogs verified 2026-09-04: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/openai/gpt-6-astra/endpoints. Replaces Sol in the async text and visual council OpenAI seat through openai_top. No effort pin: the gateway default is medium. The separate Codex apex tier pins high effort.
gpt-6-astra._pricing_note: Above 272000 input tokens, input is $20, output is $75, and cached input is $2 per 1M tokens. Verified 2026-09-04 against the OpenRouter model catalog.

gpt-5.6-sol._note: Alias `gpt-5.6` resolves to Sol. Frontier flagship for complex reasoning + coding; replaces gpt-5.2-pro AND o3. Reached over OpenRouter chat-completions (PB-0077); the /v1/responses path is retired. Reasoning effort is request-controlled (none/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) and rides the gateway's top-level reasoning_effort field; this entry pins no effort, so the model's own default applies — gpt-5.6-sol-low is the pinned-LOW alias. Rejects non-default temperature. Tools: functions, web_search, file_search, computer_use. Knowledge cutoff 2026-02-16. Pricing VERIFIED against the OpenRouter catalog 2026-08-26: $2 per 1M input / $10 per 1M output (correcting the earlier unverified $5/$30); cached-input pricing omitted pending verification.

gpt-5.6-sol-low._note: Same SKU as gpt-5.6-sol, pinned to LOW reasoning effort, for a fast lane where a flagship judgment at reduced latency and cost beats a full-effort deliberation. Mirrors the claude-fable-5.1 / claude-fable-5.1-medium effort-alias pattern. No model_roles entry resolves here today — the fast_council role this note once named does not exist — so the pin is reachable only by naming this key directly. The caller emits the pin as the top-level reasoning_effort field on OpenRouter chat-completions (PB-0077), so the LOW pin is live. Rejects non-default temperature. Pricing VERIFIED against the OpenRouter catalog 2026-08-26: $2 per 1M input / $10 per 1M output (correcting the earlier unverified $5/$30); cached-input pricing omitted pending verification.

gpt-5.6-terra._note: Balances intelligence and cost; replaces the retired 5.5-generation mid-tier model, gpt-5.2, gpt-5.2-chat-latest. Reached over OpenRouter chat-completions (PB-0077); the /v1/responses path is retired. Rejects non-default temperature. Effort request-controlled; the caller emits it as the top-level reasoning_effort field, and this entry pins no effort. Tools: functions, web_search, file_search, computer_use. Knowledge cutoff 2026-02-16. Pricing UNVERIFIED — no authoritative local source; cached-input pricing omitted pending verification.

gpt-5.6-luna._note: Cost-sensitive / high-volume. Replaces o4-mini. Reached over OpenRouter chat-completions (PB-0077); the /v1/responses path is retired. Rejects non-default temperature. gpt-image-2._note: Re-pointed at the fused OpenRouter SKU openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 — GPT-5.4 with GPT Image 2 generation fused into one chat-completions model; OpenRouter serves no standalone gpt-image-2 slug (PB-0077, verified against openrouter.ai/api/v1/models 2026-08-26). Snapshot lineage: gpt-image-2-2026-04-21, replacing gpt-image-1 (GPT Image 1.5).

claude-fable-5.1._note: Fable 5.1 replaces Fable 5. OpenRouter id, context, output limit, pricing, reasoning efforts, and temperature omission verified 2026-09-03 against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models. Capability scores are inherited estimates, not Fable 5.1 measurements. Pins HIGH effort for anthropic_top, council_arbiter, and think_deep. The async text and visual councils and the sync arbiter resolve here.

claude-fable-5.1-medium._note: Fable 5.1 replaces Fable 5. OpenRouter id, context, output limit, pricing, reasoning efforts, and temperature omission verified 2026-09-03 against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models. Capability scores are inherited estimates, not Fable 5.1 measurements. Same API model as claude-fable-5.1, pinned to MEDIUM effort for the synchronous council_default seat.

claude-opus-5._note: Successor to claude-opus-4-8; drop-in at identical economics ($5/$25 per 1M, cached $0.50), 1M context, 128K max output. Thinking is adaptive-only AND on by default (omitting `thinking` runs adaptive; disabling thinking is capped at effort<=high). Rejects the temperature param. Separate rate-limit bucket from the Opus 4.x pool. SPECS TO RE-VERIFY against a fresh anthropic-models-overview capture (pricing/context reused from Opus 4.8, which Opus 5 matches; release date intentionally omitted pending a dated source).

claude-sonnet-5._note: Replaces claude-sonnet-4-6. Effort-controlled (adaptive thinking; effort defaults to high on the Claude API + Claude Code) and REJECTS the temperature param — a behavior change from Sonnet 4.6, which accepted it (verified via platform docs 2026-07-09). $3/$15 base; introductory $2/$10 through 2026-08-31. max_output_tokens corrected to 64000 per research/sources/anthropic-models-overview (2026-06-12) verification.

gemini-3.1-pro-preview._pricing_note: TIERED: prompts >200k tokens are $4 in / $18 out. Base (<=200k) shown. -customtools endpoint variant available. Source: research/sources/gemini-api-pricing + gemini-3-1-pro-preview.

gemini-3-pro-image-preview._note: OpenRouter serves one Nano Banana Pro slug (google/gemini-3-pro-image-preview) for both generation and editing, so the former gemini-3-pro-image-preview-edit entry is folded in here (PB-0077). Its editing capabilities and per_edit cost are carried over verbatim.

gemini-3.5-flash._note: Frontier-class fast model; sub-agent/agentic-loop workhorse. Source: research/sources/gemini-3-5-flash + gemini-api-pricing.

_changelog: 2026-09-04: Register openai/gpt-6-astra from the live OpenRouter catalog and move openai_top to Astra for async text and visual councils. Preserve the synchronous Terra seat and the separate Sol/low-effort entries. | 2.1.0 (2026-09-03): Upgrade the Fable council seats and shared Fable roles to claude-fable-5.1. Preserve high/medium effort pins. Verify model metadata against the live OpenRouter catalog; cached input is $0.25 per 1M tokens. | 2.0.0 (2026-08-26): OpenRouter is the single inference gateway (PB-0077). providers collapses to one openrouter entry (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, Authorization: Bearer). Every model's provider is openrouter and its api_string is the verbatim OpenRouter id, pinned as-is and never normalized; the bare registry keys are UNCHANGED, so model_roles and every downstream reference need no edit. gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-sol-low pricing corrected to $2/$10 per 1M against the OpenRouter catalog. gemini-3-pro-image-preview-edit is FOLDED INTO gemini-3-pro-image-preview (OpenRouter serves one Nano Banana Pro slug for generation and editing) and gpt-image-2 is re-pointed at the fused SKU openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 (no standalone gpt-image-2 slug exists). claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 keeps its bare key but addresses anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5. The three council seats (gpt-5.6-sol, claude-fable-5, gemini-3.1-pro-preview) carry serving_providers, the provider.only allowlist that keeps the seats on three distinct serving hosts. openai_endpoint is DELETED from every entry — the gateway is OpenAI-compatible chat-completions only, and reasoning effort now rides the top-level reasoning_effort field. The eight reader-less blocks (judge_hierarchy, council_configurations, fallback_chains, routing_rules, pipelines, playbook_model_affinity, quality_metrics, recursive_improvement) are DELETED: nothing read them, and re-pinning them under renamed ids would be silent drift. performance_tracking is retained. | 1.5.0 (2026-07-24): Renamed the Anthropic Opus seat claude-opus-4-8 -> claude-opus-5 (Opus 5 released as the drop-in successor; identical $5/$25 per 1M pricing, cached $0.50, 1M context, 128K output, adaptive-only thinking that is now on by default). Every Opus routing seat now points at claude-opus-5: model_roles anthropic_balanced/anthropic_council/code_review/reflect/recursive_improve, judge_hierarchy, council_configurations, routing_rules, fallback chains, and pipelines (complex_refactor/documentation/architecture_decision/creative_generation reviewers). claude-fable-5 remains the flagship tier above Opus, and the sonnet/haiku cost tiers are unchanged. Pricing/context were carried over from Opus 4.8 (which Opus 5 matches) and are flagged for re-verification against a fresh anthropic-models-overview capture. Flagship hierarchy UNCHANGED: claude-fable-5 stays anthropic_top/council_arbiter/think_deep (Opus 5 kept in-place at the balanced/council/review seats). claude-opus-4-8 is REMOVED from the registry entirely — a fallback-only entry plus a `refusal_fallback` mapping were prototyped and then deliberately dropped before release because NO code read them: shipping a declarative-only mapping would have read as a live safety net that did not exist. Anthropic's server-side `fallbacks: "default"` beta is the real mechanism; wiring it is tracked as a follow-on. | 1.4.0 (2026-07-09): GPT-5.6 Sol/Sol-low/Terra/Luna is now the active OpenAI baseline (per PB-0037/PB-0038). GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-pro active identifiers were INTENTIONALLY REMOVED as part of this baseline switch — a deliberate compatibility break; they are NEVER aliased to any GPT-5.6 SKU. Imported Gemini 3.5 Flash (new model) and corrected Gemini 3.1 Pro (Preview) metadata/pricing (context_window, max_output_tokens, tiered cost, _pricing_note) from the production line's research-verified corrections (research/sources/gemini-api-pricing, gemini-3-1-pro-preview, gemini-3-5-flash); gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-2.5-flash (text) are retired in favor of these two across judge_hierarchy, council_configurations, routing_rules, and fallback_chains. claude-opus-4-8 and claude-sonnet-5 cross-verified against research/sources/anthropic-models-overview (2026-06-12); claude-sonnet-5 max_output_tokens corrected to 64000. GPT-5.6 SKU (Sol/Sol-low/Terra/Luna) cached_input_per_1m pricing was OMITTED — no authoritative local source exists for GPT-5.6 cache pricing — and each carries a Pricing UNVERIFIED note pending confirmation. claude-fable-5 and claude-fable-5-medium remain ACTIVE (not disabled) as the Anthropic flagship tier above Opus 4.8. Image models untouched.
